record.title: Validate passive private-cache reader in an isolated guest
record.intent: Verify native reads and rejection gates before any live specimen use.
requirements: Use a fresh disposable ARM64 guest and synthetic owner/cache fixture under the established offline loopback network control. Do not contact the physical scope.
Run a bounded positive observation and deliberate owner/mapping/process rejection controls. Verify exact bytes, read budget, preserved failures and no target writes or calls.
Keep guest security state and system_server stable; preserve and seal the original outcome. A failed run is a conclusion, not permission to edit evidence or silently retry.
acceptance: Native observer behavior has a preserved guest result with exact scope.
